steps.note: The butter is melted first and then pumped to the ghee boiler.
The melted butter is stirred and boiled until the froth subsides and the milk solids turn golden yellow or brown.
The residue settles and the clear fat is poured off.
The remaining residue is taken out by cloth, a pressure filter or a centrifuge.

sources.text: Heating the melted butter to 110-120 °C to drive off the water, stopping when the residue is golden to brown, and clearing it, from this chapter.
